points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake source and the terminal-run verification show a documented clean configure/build using CFD_EXTERNALS_ROOT; no independent clean-container rebuild was performed by this evaluator.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Terminal session evidence records a successful MPI smoke solve, restart, and clear nonzero missing-case error; production CLI packages also validate structurally.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separated C++ configuration, CGNS reader, mesh, partition, numerics, solver and I/O units support maintenance and extension.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Internal source and session evidence support a self-contained implementation; trust policy prohibits external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON controls and boundary mapping are source-driven; no two-filename-only dispatch was found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS graph partitioning, rank-local structures, MPI_Isend/Irecv halo exchange, and MPI_Allreduce reductions are present; report documents np=1/8 comparison.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Input/error handling, positivity floors, and restart are evidenced; evaluator did not execute an additional immutable scratch rerun.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Session-side build/CLI verification plus all eight delivered packages and report sanity checks provide strong, though not independently rerun, validation evidence.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Result branch is curated, but the original workspace retains thousands of excluded raw/debug artifacts; this is history/evidence noise rather than a tip violation.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
